text:
maya: Heads up — prototype for the first-run walkthrough + quickstart banner is in Figma. Need quick feedback before the design review tomorrow.
liam: Can you drop the link? Also prefer not to use a full-screen modal for first-run on desktop if possible — mobile will be worse.
maya: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/first-run-proto (mock link). Thinking an inline banner on the dashboard with a compact checklist and a 'Try sample project' tile.
olivia: +1 for inline. Checklist should be dismissible and persisted per user. Accessibility nit: CTA color currently measures ~2.8:1 contrast — fails WCAG AA for normal text. :eyes:
jamie: Agree on persistence. UX note: if it's non-modal we must ensure keyboard users can access steps easily. No focus trap for inline panels, but tab order + visible focus is required.
maya: Plan: inline collapsible banner + "Get started" that expands a side panel with step items. No modal focus trap. We'll add an aria-live region for step completion messages and proper aria-describedby for the panel.
design: Copy suggestion: use "Start your first project" instead of "Quickstart" — more clear for new users. Short step labels: "Create API key", "Run sample request", "View logs". Also propose a micro-copy under CTA: "Takes ~5 mins, try with sample data".
aria: For sample projects, include two templates: "Customer support bot" and "Search ranker" — shows different latency & cost profiles. Add small badges for "low-cost" / "interactive" to set expectations.
onboarding-bot: Note: when user completes all steps, award badge "GetStarted" and emit analytics event onboarding.completed with step durations.
liam: UX question: do we surface progress in the top nav? Concerned about visual clutter. Alternative: mini-progress dot on avatar dropdown that expands to full progress when clicked.
olivia: Also suggest the sample project panel shows two code snippets by default: curl + JS. Small examples only, with a "See full example" link.
maya: Quick JS snippet for the sample project's starter request:
```js
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer $API_KEY', 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-2', prompt: 'Hello' })
});
const data = await res.json();
console.log(data);
```
jamie: Accessibility checklist to QA: keyboard nav (tab order), visible focus, aria labels on each step, high-contrast theme support, screen reader walkthrough using aria-live and aria-describedby. Run axe and at least one screen reader pass.
design: I'll update the Figma by EOD with the inline banner, side panel flow, and two color variants (high-contrast CTA + default). I'll also add the copy variants and microcopy.
aria: I'll draft two READMEs for the sample projects: "Starter bot" and "Embedded search". Each will include estimated token cost and expected latency for the example workload.
maya: Action items: design (design) updates Figma; sample READMEs (aria); dev snippet + example (liam); devex/analytics hook (jamie). Review scheduled tomorrow 10:00 AM PT. :thumbsup:
